subject: Telemetry sampling reconciliation / confirmation of no external data access
messages:
From: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@clearwaterbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearwaterbank.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: sampled telemetry reconciliation after 11/14 incident

Mina —

Thanks for the update on the incident yesterday (INC-20261114-02). Our compliance team needs a short, evidence-backed reconciliation that demonstrates whether any externally identifiable customer data left Clearwater systems as a result of the event. Specifically we would like: 

- A description of the sampling methodology you used (scope, selectors, sampling rate).
- A small machine-readable sample (CSV) with request IDs and timestamps (anonymized payloads OK) and corresponding SHA256 hashes.
- A short statement about egress/egress-IP checks for the same time window.
- Any chain-of-custody or preservation artifacts.

If you could share a first-pass package by EOD Monday that would be ideal — Clearwater legal may need to include a short paragraph in their regulator response.

Lisa Monroe
Head of Security Operations
Clearwater Bank
lisa.monroe@clearwaterbank.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@clearwaterbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampled telemetry reconciliation after 11/14 incident

Lisa —

Thanks for the clear ask and apologies for the disruption. We're putting together the package you requested. High-level plan: 

1) Scope: we will sample across the impacted inference cluster for the incident window (2026-11-14T02:00:00Z to 2026-11-14T06:00:00Z).
2) Sampling: deterministic stratified sampling by request hash, target ~10,000 requests (or full set if fewer).
3) Artifacts: CSV with request_id, server_ts, model_id, anonymized input_hash (SHA256), anonymized output_hash (SHA256); separate hash_summary text file with per-batch checksums.
4) Egress check: we'll run the egress firewall/flow logs against the sampled request IDs and produce a short summary of matches (if any).
5) Preservation: chain-of-custody zip with storage locations and access logs.

We will attach the initial artifacts once the sampling job completes (ETA: within 24 hours). If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough Monday morning to go over the artifacts before you send anything to legal.

Attachments: reconciliation-checklist-CLW.pdf (plan + acceptance criteria)

— Mina Haddad
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@clearwaterbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampled telemetry reconciliation after 11/14 incident

On Mon, Nov 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Lisa —
> 
> Thanks for the clear ask and apologies for the disruption. We're putting together the package you requested. High-level plan: 
> 
> 1) Scope: we will sample across the impacted inference cluster for the incident window (2026-11-14T02:00:00Z to 2026-11-14T06:00:00Z).

Folks — quick technical summary of what we ran and what we found (full artifacts attached):

- Job: telemetry-sample-recon-20261115 (deterministic stratified sample, seed 82341)
- Sample size: 9,872 requests (below the 10k target because of dedup after filtering).
- Artifacts produced: sampled_logs_20261115.csv (request_id, server_ts, model_id, input_hash), hash_summary_20261115.txt (SHA256 per request batch), preservation_chain_20261115.pdf.
- Egress check: cross-referenced sampled request_ids against egress flow logs and outbound NAT logs for the same interval. No flows were observed with destination IPs outside our sanctioned egress ranges.
- Payload exposure check: compared input_hashes against a one-way index of known ClearBank customer identifiers supplied earlier (hashed client ids). No matches.

Representative excerpt from sampled_logs_20261115.csv (anonymized):
request_id,server_ts,model_id,input_hash
req_62f7a,2026-11-14T02:14:03Z,redwood-gpt-2-24k,6b1b36cbb04b41490bfc0ab2bfa26f86e4e0c7f5b7b2e8d72c3e6a8f9a3f7c7f
req_62fbd,2026-11-14T02:45:11Z,redwood-gpt-2-24k,3a8f1a2e5b6d4c9e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e

Conclusion (preliminary): sampled hashes do not match any known customer identifiers and egress scans show no external destinations outside our sanctioned list during the window. Full checksum file attached for your verification.

Attachments: sampled_logs_20261115.csv, hash_summary_20261115.txt, preservation_chain_20261115.pdf

— Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@clearwaterbank.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampled telemetry reconciliation after 11/14 incident

Folks —

Adding the security preservation notes and confirming chain-of-custody: 

- We snapshot the raw telemetry partition at 2026-11-14T06:15:00Z and moved the snapshot to a sealed S3 bucket with restricted ACLs. Access was granted to the named investigators only; object creation and access timestamps are included in preservation_chain_20261115.pdf.
- Hashing was performed using SHA256 via the standard pipeline (sha256sum) and the hash_summary_20261115.txt contains per-batch SHA256 aggregates plus a final aggregate digest.
- Audit trail: all accesses to the preservation bucket are logged in our audit service (link in drive). We will export an access log CSV if Clearwater requires it for regulatory submission.
- Legal note: We recommend a short, two-line statement from Redwood confirming that the reconciliation and egress scans were performed and that no external destinations were observed for the sampled set. We can provide a signed PDF statement on company letterhead for your records.

Let me know if you need any further artifacts.

— Neha Kapoor
Director, Security Assurance, Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@clearwaterbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearwaterbank.com
Date: 2026-11-17T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampled telemetry reconciliation after 11/14 incident

Mina / team —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. Clearwater compliance reviewed the package (sampled CSV + hash summary + preservation chain). That looks sufficient for our regulator briefing.

Please do send the short signed company statement (one paragraph) confirming: 1) the sampling and hashing methodology; 2) that the sampled set produced no matches to Clearwater identifiers; and 3) that no external egress destinations were observed for the sampled set during the incident window. We will attach it to our filing.

Once we have that signed PDF we can close this request on our side. Appreciated.

— Lisa
Head of Security Operations
Clearwater Bank
